PRTS 终端保存消息历史和邮件。仓库放不下的物品、运营账单和各种通知都会发到这: The PRTS terminal keeps your message history and mail. Items the warehouse can't hold, upkeep bills and notices all arrive here. Press Enter to open it at any time.
PRTS：欠款超过额度两倍，已变卖持仓还款。: PRTS: Debt is over twice the credit limit. Holdings were sold to repay it.
上方是账户总览。账户净值 = 龙门币 + 赤金与外币折算 + 存款 + 证券与策: Up top is the account summary. Net worth = LMD + gold and foreign currency at current rates + deposits + securities and strategies + Rhodes stock − debt. Items in your personal warehouse don't count. Your borrowing limit is based on net worth.
两个标的协整才开仓：价差偏离均值超过偏离阈值进场，回到 0.1σ 以内平仓；连续: Trades two cointegrated markets: enters when the spread strays past the band, exits within 0.1σ of the mean; closes after 3 days without cointegration.
中间是策略的净值曲线、收益、最大回撤、胜率和持仓。策略每天按占用资金收 0.05: In the middle are the strategy's value curve, return, max drawdown, win rate and positions. Each strategy pays a 0.05% daily custody fee on the capital it uses; if Rhodes Island falls into arrears, strategies are paused first.
中间是选中企业的 K 线、关键比率、护城河 12 项（达标越多，经营越稳）和季报: In the middle are the selected company's chart, key ratios, its 12 moat checks (the more it passes, the steadier the business) and quarterly reports. Companies publish revenue, net income and dividends each quarter.
九大势力对罗德岛的关系、修正项和解锁的特权。关系从冷漠升到崇拜，每升一级有礼物；: The nine factions' standing with Rhodes Island, its modifiers and the privileges unlocked. Standing rises from Indifferent to Exalted, with a gift at each rank. Gift packs are sent from here too.
交易所 3 级开 1 个策略槽，4 级开 2 个，科研“量化交易”再加 1 个。: The Exchange opens 1 strategy slot at Lv3 and 2 at Lv4; the Quantitative Trading research adds 1 more. Hover over a strategy's name to see its rules.
交易所买来的大类包在这里拆开，按点数自选里面的物品。: Open category packs bought at the Exchange here, picking their contents with points.
交易所燃料盘的报价单位，一桶 480 单位燃料。: The exchange's fuel lot: one barrel holds 480 units of fuel.
借款随借随还，没有到期日，按天复利。额度跟着净资产变，借得越接近额度利率越高。自: Borrow and repay at any time; there is no due date, and interest compounds daily. The limit follows your net worth, and the closer you borrow to it, the higher the rate. Auto-repay uses any balance above 3 days of upkeep each day. Debt above 1.5x the limit is overdue: all LMD income goes to the debt first. Above 2x, strategy positions, securities, term deposits and demand deposits are sold off in that order.
减缓地图特色（污染、寒冷、血债）的随队物资，买下后下一份合同自动带上。: Squad supplies that ease a map's feature (contamination, cold, blood debt). Once bought, they go with you on the next contract.
出发前吃一份做好的补给，下一份合同中生效。停发补给的日子不能用餐。: Eat a prepared supply before you leave; it works for the next contract. You can't eat on days when supplies are stopped.
出发前最后确认：出战干员、身上装备、背包和安全袋。确认无误后出击。: A last check before leaving: the operator, gear worn, pack and secure pouch. When all is ready, deploy.
出发前的增益集中在这里：食堂补给、科研课题、药剂和随队物资。各部门的入口仍然保留: Pre-departure boosts in one place: canteen supplies, research projects, potions and squad supplies. Each department's own entrance is still there.
到期的远期交货合约在这里交割：背包里的材料够数就能交货。: Settle due forward delivery contracts here: with enough of the material in your pack, you can deliver.
区间内跌破下沿又收回且放量时买入；放量突破上沿时加仓；回落进区间离场；止损设在弹: Buys a dip below the range that recovers on rising volume; adds on a high-volume break above it; exits on a fall back into the range; stop below the spring bar's low.
升级获得属性点，分配到各项属性上。每点的效果写在旁边。: Levelling up gives attribute points to spend on attributes. What each point does is shown beside it.
升级获得技能点，用来点亮技能树。: Levelling up gives skill points to light up the skill tree.
可露希尔代售的交易包。在基地按锚地代售，营地按地图代售；可以买，也可以把自己的交: Trade packs Closure sells on consignment: at the base by anchorage, in camps by map. You can buy, or hand her your own packs to sell.
右侧买卖股份。持有股份可以拿分红；持股达到 5% 会公开，各势力都会知道。下方是: Buy and sell shares on the right. Shareholders receive dividends; a stake of 5% or more becomes public, and every faction will know. Below are the major holders and the PRTS note.
各地区货币盘与交叉盘。可以换汇、持有外币或做外汇差价合约。干员薪资按家乡货币支付: Regional currency books and cross rates. Exchange, hold foreign currency, or trade FX CFDs. Operator salaries are paid in their home currency, so holding it hedges the rate.
各地的行情新闻。新闻会推动相关商品和企业的价格，各势力也会据此买卖。: Market news from every region. News moves the prices of related goods and companies, and the factions trade on it.
和交易所资产页的信贷是同一笔：随借随还，按天计息，额度跟着净资产变。: The same credit line as on the Exchange's Assets page: borrow and repay any time, daily interest, a limit that follows your net worth.
和后勤柜台一样：为装备投保后，没带回的会在 2 到 4 小时后由罗德岛小队送回。: Same as the Logistics Counter: insured gear that isn't brought back is returned by the Rhodes squad in 2 to 4 hours. Standard-issue gear needs no insurance.
在下沿到上沿之间等距挂买卖单，跌了买、涨了卖。: Places evenly spaced orders between the bottom and the top: buys on dips, sells on rises.
基础研究没有上限，每升一级提供一点永久加成，费用逐级提高。: Basic research has no cap: each level gives a small permanent bonus, and costs rise with each level.
增长调整市盈率（PEG）不高于买入 PEG 且净现金为正时买入；PEG 高于卖出: Buys when PEG is at or below the buy PEG and net cash is positive; sells when PEG rises above the sell PEG or the firm turns cyclical.
存款页存活期或定存；证券页买赤金产品和债券；企业页买上市企业的股份；策略页让自动: Put money in demand or term deposits on the Deposits page; buy gold products and bonds on Securities; buy listed companies' shares on Companies; let automated strategies trade for you on Strategies. Higher returns come with bigger swings.
左侧是上市企业。市盈率 = 股价 ÷ 每股收益；PEG = 市盈率 ÷ 利润增长: Listed companies are on the left. P/E = share price / earnings per share; PEG = P/E / earnings growth, shown green below 1 and orange above 2.
左侧是九大势力的商品盘，中间是 K 线，右侧下单：现货立即成交，挂单等价格到了再: The nine factions' goods books are on the left, the chart in the middle, orders on the right: spot fills now, a limit order fills when the price gets there, a forward delivers on a set day, and a CFD goes long or short with leverage. Run short of margin and it is liquidated.
左侧是净值走势和景气指数。景气由货价、势力、情绪和信贷松紧组成；信贷越紧，基础贷: On the left are your net worth over time and the business cycle. The cycle combines goods prices, factions, mood and credit tightness; the tighter credit is, the higher the base loan rate and the harder it is for companies to expand.
左侧是赤金产品：赤金存单按赤金计息，两只基金持有一篮子企业股份并定期派息。右侧是: Gold products are on the left: the gold certificate earns interest in gold, and the two funds hold baskets of company shares and pay out regularly. Bonds are on the right: 3- or 7-day terms, a coupon above term deposits, principal back at maturity. Sold early, they go at market price, which moves with rates.
当前干员的数值与成长。概览页列出全部最终数值，右侧名册可以切换查看其他干员。: The current operator's stats and growth. The overview lists every final stat; the roster on the right switches to other operators.
把一份补给交给企鹅物流寄出，外勤时在罗德岛小队处领取。: Send a supply with Penguin Logistics and pick it up from the Rhodes squad in the field.
把个人仓库的材料转入罗德岛库存，供设施日账和食堂口粮消耗。只能转入，不能取回也不: Move materials from your personal warehouse into Rhodes stock, for facility upkeep and canteen rations. Transfers are one-way: they can't be taken back or sold. The right side shows how many days each family will last.
把同一大类的物资打成交易包，交易所只按大类包交易。仓库里按 P 键也可以一键打包: Pack goods of one category into a trade pack; the Exchange trades only category packs. Press P in the warehouse to pack in one go.
把收藏品打成礼品包，在沙盘的势力页送给势力，可以提升关系。: Pack collectibles into a gift pack and send it to a faction from the Sand Table's Factions page to raise your standing.
把背包与安全袋里的物品存进仓库。可以一键入库，也可以逐件拖动。仓库放不下的会进: Store what's in your pack and secure pouch in the warehouse, all at once or by dragging. Whatever doesn't fit goes to PRTS mail.
把背包里的普通材料交给可露希尔，付交付价 20% 的赤金，物品送回仓库。药剂和特: Leave ordinary materials from your pack with Closure for 20% of their delivery value in gold, and they go back to the warehouse. No potions or special materials.
护城河 12 条达标数不低于门槛时买入长持；跌到门槛减 3 以下卖出；每期季报后: Buys and holds firms meeting at least the moat minimum of the 12 checks; sells below the minimum minus 3; rechecks after each quarterly report.
持有利率高的外币吃利差；汇率不利超过止损就平仓。: Holds high-rate currencies for the carry; closes when the rate moves against it past the stop.
按前缀数量和品质过滤地上的装备名牌，低于条件的不再显示。: Filter gear nameplates on the ground by prefix count and quality; anything below your settings isn't shown.
按实时汇率在外币和龙门币之间兑换。: Exchange foreign currency and LMD at live rates.
整层地图，撤离信标、入口和合同目标都标在上面。: The whole floor's map, with extraction beacons, entrances and contract targets marked.
整理箱在仓库里只算 1 件，里面可以装多件物品，可以原地升级到 4 级。: A case counts as 1 item in the warehouse but holds many, and can be upgraded in place up to Lv4.
日线 EMA15 / EMA200 定方向，1 小时 MACD 定动能，15 分: Daily EMA15/EMA200 sets the direction, hourly MACD the momentum, 15-minute RSI the pullback; enters only when all three agree.
本次行动拿到的藏品都在这里，效果持续到行动结束。图鉴页记录见过的全部藏品。: Every relic picked up this operation is here; their effects last until it ends. The codex records every relic you've seen.
每个交易日按价值分 × 质量分把上市企业聚成若干簇，做多均分最高的一簇，做空均分: Each trading day, clusters the listed firms by value score × quality score, goes long the best cluster and short the worst.
每个交易日，每名在舰干员吃 1 份基础作物，只从罗德岛库存扣，作物只能在农业部自: Each trading day, every operator aboard eats 1 basic crop, taken only from Rhodes stock; crops can only be grown in Agriculture. If there's enough, the ship gets a hot meal: +3% max HP on sorties. If not, supplies are stopped; top up, then press Serve at the canteen to restore them.
每隔固定小时数买入固定金额。: Buys a fixed amount every set number of hours.
活期随存随取，按天计息。定存 1、3、7 天，期限越长利率越高，提前取出没收利息: Demand deposits can be added or withdrawn at any time and earn daily interest. Term deposits run 1, 3 or 7 days; longer terms pay more, and breaking one early forfeits the interest. Deposited money is lent to the market, loosening the credit pool.
浓缩压制的固态燃料块，取暖和野外加热都靠它。: Pressed blocks of concentrated solid fuel, for warmth and field heating.
用材料和龙门币改造装备的前缀：重铸、校准和精调。: Rework gear prefixes with materials and LMD: reroll, calibrate and fine-tune.
用赤金买燃料和缓解地图特色的补给，直接放进背包。: Buy fuel and supplies that ease the map's feature with gold; they go straight into your pack.
用赤金处理污染或血债，每个营地一次。: Pay gold to treat contamination or blood debt, once per camp.
疑似狙击罗德岛头寸: is suspected of targeting Rhodes' positions
目标页是这份合同要完成的事；订单页是各部门订单需要的物资，带回后在出库区交付。: The Objectives page is what this contract asks for; the Orders page lists what department orders need. Bring them back and deliver them at the Outbound Area.
矿井事故停产: halts output after a mine accident
突破前若干根 K 线的最高价、且在 MA50 和 MA200 之上时买入；跌破前: Buys a break above the recent high while above MA50 and MA200; exits below the recent low; may add on in steps, raising the stop.
罗德岛库存专供设施消耗，在仓管台从个人仓库转入，只能转入、不能取回。行情低时买进: Rhodes stock exists for facilities to consume. Move materials in from your personal warehouse at the Depot Desk; transfers are one-way. Buying low and moving it in locks in your upkeep cost early. Nothing in your personal warehouse is ever taken automatically.
背包里是这次带出来的物品。右键使用或装备，拖动可以整理、丢弃或拖到快捷栏绑定药剂: Your pack holds what you've brought this time. Right-click to use or equip; drag to arrange, drop, or bind a potion to the hotbar. Items in the secure pouch are kept even if you fall.
课题签下后持续 3 次出击，每次出发时收取费用，期间提供加成。课题位有限。: A signed project lasts 3 sorties, charging its fee at each departure and giving its bonus meanwhile. Project slots are limited.
赤金实物可以存入赤金账户，账户里的赤金可以直接交易。下方是九大势力对罗德岛的关系: Gold bars can be deposited into the gold account, where they can be traded directly. Below is each of the nine factions' standing with Rhodes Island; the higher the rank, the better the terms.
运营页是罗德岛的日账。每个交易日（和现实日期同步），各设施消耗一族材料：先从罗德: The Upkeep page is Rhodes Island's daily bill. Each trading day (in step with the real date), every facility consumes one family of materials: first from Rhodes stock, and any shortfall is bought automatically at market price. Operator salaries are converted from their home currencies. More and higher-level facilities cost more.
运货途中遇险: runs into trouble on a delivery
这次行动的结果：赤金、合同报酬、深度与可交付的订单。: This operation's results: gold, contract reward, depth and orders you can deliver.
远期合约、差价合约和挂单都列在这里，带浮动盈亏。保证金不足时可以追加保证金或平仓: Forwards, CFDs and limit orders are all listed here with floating P/L. When margin runs low you can add margin or close.
连续抛售库存，传闻减产: keeps selling stock; output cuts rumored
选好模板，设定资金、止损线（净值回撤到这里就停）、运行天数、参数和标的。先点回测: Pick a template and set the capital, stop line (it stops when its value falls this far), days to run, parameters and targets. Backtest first on historical candles, free, 10 times a day; start it when you're satisfied.
重工、移动城市地块、建材: Heavy industry, city blocks, building materials
龙门币不够付日账时会自动借款，按天计息。额度用完或逾期后按顺序暂停：交易所策略、: If LMD can't cover upkeep, it is borrowed automatically with daily interest. Once the limit runs out or the debt is overdue, these pause in order: Exchange strategies, Processing, Agriculture, Research. The workbench, warehouse and sorties always work, and everything resumes as soon as the debt is cleared.
龙门币是罗德岛的资金：合同报酬、出库订单、卖货、分红和利息都进余额，建设、升级、: LMD is Rhodes Island's money: contract rewards, outbound orders, sales, dividends and interest all go into the balance, and construction, upgrades, upkeep and salaries come out of it. Gold is the in-operation currency; deposit it in the gold account or sell it to Closure for LMD. The balance itself earns no interest.
